_note: Curated parameter descriptions, merged into the OpenAPI snapshot by scripts/sync-openapi-docs.mjs. Keyed by 'METHOD path'. The schema is the source of truth for which params exist and their type/required; this only supplies human copy. A param with no entry here falls back to the schema description (often empty).

POST /api/v1/checkout/sessions/.amount: Payment amount as a decimal string (e.g., "5000.00"). 0 is allowed for voucher-redemption flows; negative amounts are rejected.
POST /api/v1/checkout/sessions/.currency: ISO 4217 currency code. One of: NGN, ZAR, UGX, KES, GHS, TZS, RWF, XOF, XAF.
POST /api/v1/checkout/sessions/.reference: Your unique order/invoice reference (max 100 chars, unique per org).
POST /api/v1/checkout/sessions/.customer: Customer info: {email, phone, name}. Email required for card payments.
POST /api/v1/checkout/sessions/.metadata: Custom key-value pairs returned in webhooks.
POST /api/v1/checkout/sessions/.allowed_countries: Restrict to specific countries (e.g., ["NG", "ZA"]). Omit for all enabled countries.
POST /api/v1/checkout/sessions/.allowed_providers: Restrict to specific providers (e.g., ["paystack", "onegate"]). Omit for all enabled providers.
POST /api/v1/checkout/sessions/.mode: "hosted" (redirect to Paymoja checkout page, default) or "embedded" (you render your own UI — see Headless / Embedded Checkout).

POST /api/v1/checkout/{session_token}/pa.payment_method: Method code from the methods endpoint (e.g., "credit_card", "eft", "card").
POST /api/v1/checkout/{session_token}/pa.customer: {email, phone} — email required for card payments.
